payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all team size splits, finds min experience difference delta, then enumerates all combinations of heroes assigned to teams of those sizes to maximize total within-team likings.
payload.rationale: Solution brute-forces all partitions of 7 heroes into three teams using itertools.combinations, a direct permutation/combination enumeration without backtracking, branch-and-bound, or bitmasks.
